title: The False Alarm
logline: A scientific outpost is locked down under quarantine, and desperate researchers need samples smuggled out to prove they are safe.

roles.description: Terrified, coughing, convinced they aren't infected.
Following orders, refusing to take any risks.
The military force holding the quarantine line.

public_situation: An outpost has been completely sealed off due to a suspected biological hazard.
private_truth: The hazard is a false alarm triggered by a faulty sensor, but the military is using it as an excuse to seize the lab's research.

beats.public_change: The military extends the quarantine duration indefinitely.

missions.reason: Needs blood samples smuggled to an independent lab to prove they are uninfected.
missions.private_fact: The scientist knows the military is deleting their research databanks.

beats.public_change: The independent lab confirms the samples are clean.

missions.reason: Needs an encrypted hard drive of their remaining research smuggled out before the military wipes it.
missions.private_fact: The research proves a major military contractor is using illegal materials.

beats.public_change: The military prepares to 'purge' the outpost to contain the 'infection'.

missions.reason: Needs a pilot to distract the blockade ships long enough for an escape pod to launch.
missions.private_fact: The pod's life support is failing; this is a one-way trip if they aren't picked up immediately.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot must decide what to do with the evidence.

options.label: Show the evidence to the blockade commander

resolutions.summary: The scientists escape with their research. The military's false quarantine is exposed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails or abandons the missions.
resolutions.summary: The outpost is purged. The research is stolen and the scientists are killed.
The blockade commanders see the evidence and lift the quarantine, defying their orders.

loose_threads.detail: The 'faulty' sensor was manufactured by a company owned by the military contractor.
The purge orders were signed three days before the quarantine was even announced.

radio_hooks: Military denies allegations of heavy-handed quarantine tactics.
Outpost lockdown enters its second week.

voice_direction.trapped_scientist: Desperate, frantic, losing hope and speaking very fast.
voice_direction.quarantine_enforcer: Cold, robotic, refuses to acknowledge humanity.
